definitions.meaning: a citrus tree bearing round segmented fruit
the Dutch royal dynasty, the House of Nassau's line descended from William the Silent

explanation.surface: A two-word note pointing at a treehouse.
explanation.definitionFit: The citrus tree shares the name, and the Dutch royal family is the House of that name.

indicators.note: upsetting the words no sense tips their letters over into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone complains that being upset about unanimous agreement makes no sense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upsetting' rearranges the seven letters of NO SENSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Unanimity is complete agreement, a state of being united as one.

definitions.meaning: to gather together into a mass or total
sand, gravel or crushed stone mixed with cement

explanation.surface: An instruction to gather the ingredients for mixing concrete.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to gather into a whole; as a noun it is the stone and gravel mixed into concrete.

indicators.note: crooked means bent out of shape, so the letters of the word sueing are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A dishonest but brilliant person brings lawsuits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crooked' rearranges SUEING; the odd spelling is there for the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A person of exceptional intellect is a clever type.

clue.text: I have entered inebriated to have a good time

indicators.note: entered tells us one piece has gone inside another, like someone going into a room

parts.note: lit up is slang for drunk

explanation.surface: Someone admits they came in drunk, keen to party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entered' puts IVE inside LIT UP.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to enjoy oneself with lavish celebration.

clue.text: I turn to a matter of trivial importance

indicators.note: turn tells us the little word to is flipped round to face the other way

explanation.surface: Someone shifts their attention to a minor issue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' reverses TO into OT, between I and A.
explanation.definitionFit: The smallest Greek letter has come to mean the tiniest amount, as in 'not one bit'.

clue.text: International trade fair certain to get publicity

parts.note: an expo is a large international exhibition

explanation.surface: A company attending a big international exhibition is guaranteed media attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Exposure is public attention, as in coverage in the media.

clue.text: Often thought to include part of the decimal system

indicators.note: to include says the letters sit within the run of the words often thought

explanation.surface: A remark about something commonly believed to belong to the decimal system.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to include' signals the letters running across 'ofTEN THought'.
explanation.definitionFit: One place after the decimal point counts in units of one part in ten, a basic decimal fraction.

clue.text: Hidden danger that may trap miners

definitions.text: Hidden danger that may trap miners

parts.words: Hidden danger that may trap miners
parts.note: a concealed hazard, taken literally as a collapse in a coal mine that could fall on the workers

explanation.surface: A warning about a concealed hazard in a mine.
explanation.definitionFit: A pitfall is a concealed snag, and literally a fall in a mine pit could trap miners.

parts.note: reads as a car ablaze, but means the vehicle that goes to fires, the motor named for fire

explanation.surface: Someone's car seems to have burst into flames.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a burning car; the reading is the motor that comes before the word fire, a fire engine.
explanation.definitionFit: A motor is an engine, and the fire-fighting vehicle is called a fire engine.

indicators.note: devious means winding or crooked, so the letters of nepotist take a twisted route

explanation.surface: An urgent call to unmask someone giving jobs to relatives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'devious' rearranges NEPOTIST.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiom urging someone to go faster, originally pressing the accelerator.

indicators.note: treatment of the word medical works its letters over into another order

explanation.surface: A question of why doctors bother treating patients.
explanation.walkthrough: 'treatment' rearranges MEDICAL; 'The point' stands for a decimal point.
explanation.definitionFit: The dot separating whole numbers from fractions is called a decimal point.

clue.text: Shot by firing squad and carried out

definitions.meaning: put to death as a punishment
performed or accomplished, as a plan

explanation.surface: A grim account of an execution that was duly performed.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both putting someone to death and completing a task.

parts.note: a condition with spasms in the bronchial tubes, sounding like disruption to an airline

explanation.surface: A complaint about an airline's intermittent problems.
explanation.walkthrough: 'airways' suggests an airline with erratic service, but it means the breathing passages.
explanation.definitionFit: Asthma is a respiratory condition with spasms of the bronchial passages.

clue.text: The star is upset by what anonymous letters may contain

indicators.note: is upset means the words the star are knocked over and come back in another order

explanation.surface: A celebrity is distressed by poison-pen letters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is upset' rearranges THE STAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsigned poison-pen letters often contain menacing warnings of harm.

indicators.note: make tells us to construct a new word from the letters of ears

explanation.surface: Something embarrassing makes someone's ears go hot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make' rearranges EARS.
explanation.definitionFit: To sear is to scorch the surface with intense heat.

definitions.meaning: removing cash from a bank account
pulling back or retreating from a place or activity

explanation.surface: Drawing on savings once you stop working.
explanation.definitionFit: It means both a removal of cash from an account and a retreat or pulling out.

indicators.note: within signals one piece placed inside another

parts.note: wits means powers of reasoning, as in 'use your wits'

indicators.note: maybe suggests the word sense could be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: A person finally becomes sensible, at least to a reasonable extent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges SENSE into NESSE, and 'within' puts it inside WITS.
explanation.definitionFit: To witness something is to see it happen.

clue.text: Conflict in which counter charges may be decisive?

definitions.text: Conflict in which counter charges may be decisive?

parts.words: Conflict in which counter charges may be decisive?
parts.note: counter charges look like legal accusations, but are prices at a shop counter in a battle between retailers

explanation.surface: A dispute decided by rival accusations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'counter charges' suggests countercharges in a dispute; read as shop-counter prices, it is shops undercutting each other.
explanation.definitionFit: Competing shops cut prices to beat rivals, a commercial battle.

clue.text: Decisive court action for one seeking a divorce?

definitions.meaning: a game in tennis settling a tied set, played on court
jokingly, a person wanting to break the marriage tie

explanation.surface: Legal action decides a divorce case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'court' suggests a law court, but it is a tennis court.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis it settles a tied set; whimsically, a person who breaks a marital tie.

clue.text: Where the stage is set for an operation

definitions.text: Where the stage is set for an operation

parts.words: Where the stage is set for an operation
parts.note: sounds like scenery prepared for a performance, but means the room where surgeons operate

explanation.surface: A remark about preparations before a major undertaking.
explanation.definitionFit: The building with a stage hosts plays, and the hospital room for surgery shares its name.

clue.text: Word associated with poker -it's not flush

definitions.meaning: a form of poker with some cards dealt face up
a raised knob or boss standing proud of a surface

explanation.surface: A card player explains the game, noting they lack a flush.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flush' suggests a poker hand, but means level with a surface.
explanation.definitionFit: It names a poker variant, and a raised boss or rivet head that projects rather than sitting level.

clue.text: Cacophony from dance club over the way

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: a disco is a club for dancing
Rd is short for road, a way

explanation.surface: Noise from a nightclub across the street.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry, 'over' places DISCO above RD.
explanation.definitionFit: Discord is a harsh clash of sounds, a jarring noise.

clue.text: I hesitate to claim such valuable fur

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitation
saying 'mine' is how one claims something

explanation.surface: Someone is reluctant to claim an expensive fur as their own.
explanation.walkthrough: ER is the hesitation noise, and 'Mine!' is what you say to claim something.
explanation.definitionFit: The white winter coat of the stoat is a costly fur used on ceremonial robes.

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the word ten might be arranged differently

explanation.surface: A card player draws the ten of diamonds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges TEN into ENT. ICE is criminal slang for diamonds.
explanation.definitionFit: To entice is to lure or attract someone in.

indicators.note: by pronouncement means we go by how a word is spoken

explanation.surface: A leaflet that came with an official announcement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by pronouncement' means TRACKED (followed) is said aloud, giving the sound of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A tract is a short pamphlet, often religious or political.

indicators.note: round means one part surrounds another
wildly signals that the letters of streaks go every which way
mid points to the centre letter of the word afternoon

explanation.surface: People run naked through the afternoon, and the clue asks if this is how.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wildly' rearranges STREAKS, and 'round' wraps it around R, the centre letter of 'afternoon' picked by 'mid'.
explanation.definitionFit: Streakers run naked, which British slang calls starkers.

indicators.note: odd bits means the letters in odd-numbered positions of the word Berliner

explanation.surface: A German has scraps of cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd bits' takes the 1st, 3rd, 5th and 7th letters of Berliner.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft French cheese with a white rind is a famous variety.

parts.note: a side, a group of players, plus a line, a job: joint effort by a group

explanation.surface: Helping out on the side as a secondary activity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sideline' looks like a sidelined activity; split it into side (a team) and line (work).
explanation.definitionFit: Players working together as a group is co-operative effort.

clue.text: Debacle in providing returns as a company

indicators.note: returns means the word for providing comes back facing the other way

parts.note: if means providing, as in on condition that

explanation.surface: A firm's poor returns turn into a disaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' reverses IF, giving FI.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiasco is a humiliating failure, a complete mess.

parts.note: used intimidation to wring cash from someone

explanation.surface: A gangster obtains money through intimidation.
explanation.definitionFit: To extort is to obtain money through threats or force.

definitions.meaning: written in verse, put into poetry

explanation.surface: A clever poet.
explanation.definitionFit: It means rendered in poetry, and also practised or knowledgeable in a subject.
